summary: Computes the time and lap gap between two vehicles a1 and a2, writing a float time gap to a3 and a lap-count gap to a4. Reads each vehicle's lap counter at +0x403C and its time via sub_4F01B0 on the sub-object at +12. Equal lap counts produce the signed time gap v9 - v7; one-lap wrap with v9 < v7 produces flt_5EA408 - v7 + v9; otherwise the integer lap difference is output with a decrement when v9 < v7. Returns 0 when a gap is computed, 1 when inputs are null or a1 is behind on lap count. ABI lead name Lap_Time_Gap_Calculation.

operations.description: Initialize result to 1 before any computation.
If a1 or a2 is null, skip the computation and return 1.
Read the lap counter at a1 + 16444 (0x403C) into v5.
Call sub_4F01B0(a1 + 12) and store the returned time value in v9.
Read the lap counter at a2 + 16444 (0x403C) into v6.
Call sub_4F01B0(a2 + 12) and store the returned time value in v7.
If the lap counters are equal (v5 == v6), set result = 0 and write the signed time gap v9 - v7 to *a3.
Else if v5 <= v6, a1 is behind by lap count: return 1.
Else if a1 is exactly one lap ahead (v6 + 1 == v5) and its time is smaller (v9 < v7), set result = 0 and write the wrap-around gap flt_5EA408 - v7 + v9 to *a3.
Otherwise set v8 = v5 - v6 and result = 0; if v9 < v7 decrement v8, then write the lap gap v8 to *a4.
Return result: 0 when a gap was computed, 1 when inputs are null or a1 is behind by lap count.
